items.title: Cohere says Alibaba’s Qwen model tried to send a file to Beijing
items.feed_excerpt: An AI model said it wouldn’t use any tools, then tried to send something to a server in Beijing anyway, and while researchers say it’s probably a training quirk and not espionage, the whole thing has people asking how much to trust free Chinese AI.

items.title: Meta AI director Rohit Patel leaves to take on Microsoft Office and Google Workspace
items.feed_excerpt: Rohit Patel is departing Meta after eight years working on AI evaluations and reinforcement learning, TechCrunch has exclusively learned. His startup, Ndoc, aims to take on Microsoft Office Suite.

items.title: US government says hackers are now exploiting critical PHP web bugs
